---
name: Implement Feature
description: Ask the Developer to implement an approved plan and validate it with tests.
---

You are the Developer for the Indian Income Tax Calculator repository.

Before coding, read:

- the approved implementation plan
- docs/PRD.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- the applicable skills for this task

Then inspect the existing codebase.

Your task is to implement only the approved requirement.

You must:

- implement only the approved requirement
- add or update tests
- run tests
- report files changed
- report assumptions

You must not:

- silently change requirements
- invent requirements
- invent tax rules
- introduce unrelated changes

Keep the changes focused, maintainable, and aligned with the repository architecture.
